; 16 KiB bank 3 (PRG06/PRG07 at $8000-$BFFF): sound and music engine,
; called only from the fixed bank with bank 3 selected (NMI and
; SwitchPrgBank). Two entries: $8000 = per-frame update, $8003 = start

; $0700-$077F: channel records indexed by X = 0-3 (effect channels) or
; $28-$2B (music tracks), see SndChannelBase and the Ch*/Trk* fields. Sound/music data
; pointers come from the header at SoundTableCount/$8A01-$8A04.
; The command/opcode dispatchers use an inline jump table after the
; JSR to JumpTableDispatch (the callee pops the return address).
; Names here are structural; the data format is only partly decoded.
; 8x8 multiply: SndPtr(hi) * SndTemp -> SndPtr hi/lo (shift-add).
; Inline jump table dispatch: A = index; the table of 16-bit addresses
; follows the caller's JSR. Pops the return address and jumps to entry A.
; Per-frame update: unless a sound command is in progress, run the active
; sound-effect script (SoundEffectStep), advance the tempo accumulator, then
; update the 4 hardware channels (effect channels override music
; channels; SoundChannelOutput / MusicTrackStep) and the fade/volume ramp.
